title: Brik deployment journal event
description: One append-only, file-per-event record of the DeploymentJournal (deployments/YYYY/MM/DD/<ts>-<uid>.json in the state-repo). Env-scoped: every event records one observed deploy of one digest to one environment. The digest binds the event to the artifact (anti-replay); definition_hash pins the rendered definition that was applied (the drift anchor: status re-derives it from version_ref/env_config_ref and compares); run_id/run_url/actor are orchestrator traceability, informational only. Authorship and integrity come from the signed git commit that appends the file, never from fields inside the document.
